cues.text: The graduation ceremony, in the school auditorium. You sit in the seats facing the stage with Junpei and Yukari. On the stage, a teacher stands at the podium; Mitsuru waits off to one side.
The teacher steps away from the podium and walks off, and Mitsuru crosses to take his place.
Her head lowered, Mitsuru steps away from the podium and walks off the stage.
